where_ai_enters.primary_mechanism: Source-grounded retrieval and conversational synthesis of current regulations, internal policies, and prior approved interpretations.
where_ai_enters.optional_secondary_mechanism: Reranking of effective, authoritative, and role-permitted sources.
where_ai_enters.llm: Used only for grounded synthesis and clarification; it does not determine compliance, approve product changes, or execute controls.
where_ai_enters.human_control: Compliance, legal, risk, and control owners validate applicability, effective dates, interpretations, evidence, exceptions, and any operational or customer-impacting decision.
